data.cultural_impact: The name Keshu holds great significance in Hindu culture, primarily due to its association with Goddess Kali. Worship of this goddess is popular in Hinduism, especially in Bengal and other regions of India. Devotees believe that invoking the goddess through chants and puja (worship) can provide strength, protection, and fast relief from troubles.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Keshu can evoke feelings of devotion, courage, and spiritual growth. It reminds us of the power of the divine, and the resilience and strength we can draw from them during difficult times. Moreover, it can inspire us to let our inner light, symbolized by our hair, shine brightly just like the divine mother Kali.
